title: Native npm workspace dependency graph
expected: The app consumes a shared package through workspace metadata.
Changing shared code affects the app; changing app code does not rebuild unrelated targets.

cases.name: duplicate-execution
cases.change: Select both workspace root and package targets.
cases.expect: Do not run the same native workspace task twice.

limitations: Oyzu CLI/build/agent integration is pending; native checks do not prove policy, sandbox, cache, reporting, or release behavior.
